== Notes ==
* This skill is used by [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin]]s summoned via [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support]].

== Trivia ==
* The skill name derives from East Asian mythologies in which the Nine-Tail Fox is a spirit or demon. The Chinese call it [[W:Huli Jing|Huli Jing]], the Japanese call it [[W:Kitsune|Kitsune]], and the Koreans call it [[W:Kumiho|Kumiho]].
* Taking note to the statement above, the effect of this skill is similar to Assassin skills with the prefix "Fox": like other "Fox" titled attacks, it cannot be blocked.
